title: Harden port allocation and conflict reporting
description: Make automatic port selection bounded, race-aware, and explicit about conflicts or exhausted ranges for all methods that allocate ports.
acceptanceCriteria: Port selection stays within the configured range and returns a clear error when exhausted
A race between concurrent allocations is detected/retried or serialized without duplicate listeners
An occupied requested port produces a specific conflict error rather than a generic tunnel failure
Tests cover start, middle, end, exhaustion, occupied port, and concurrent allocation cases

steps.description: Use a deterministic port fixture to cover range boundaries, occupied ports, exhaustion, and concurrent requests.

steps.details: Locate `findFreePort` and all method/API callers, then identify the smallest shared fix that avoids duplicated logic.

steps.description: Add reservation/serialization only where needed and return typed/actionable errors without changing API compatibility.
Run port tests, custom harness, typecheck, and lint.

technicalNotes: Do not assume an OS-level check is atomic; document the chosen reservation strategy.
